question: Is there a ground-truth-free, serve-time per-query signal (score-distribution QPP statistics, result-set coherence) that predicts whether base or BoD should be served for that query -- well enough to beat always-BoD?

config.coherence_definition: mean off-diagonal cosine among the top-10 result vectors (same encoder that retrieved them)
config.api_note: $0 -- win/loss labels, junk@10 and qrels metrics all reused from bestbuy_base_vs_bod_divergence.json; no new judge calls

routing.population: all 250 holdout queries (the real serving population)

zdiff_top1_sim.rule: serve whichever model has the higher top1_sim

zdiff_mean_top10_sim.rule: serve whichever model has the higher mean_top10_sim

zdiff_gap12.rule: serve whichever model has the higher gap12

zdiff_gap1_mean.rule: serve whichever model has the higher gap1_mean

zdiff_std_top10.rule: serve whichever model has the higher std_top10

zdiff_coherence.rule: serve whichever model has the higher coherence

zdiff_centroid_sim.rule: serve whichever model has the higher centroid_sim

zdiff_media_share.rule: serve whichever model has the higher media_share

best_in_sample_rule.note: IN-SAMPLE optimum -- feature and threshold chosen on the same 250 queries

combined.note: IN-SAMPLE optimum -- feature and threshold chosen on the same 250 queries

junk.note: IN-SAMPLE optimum -- feature and threshold chosen on the same 250 queries

hit.note: IN-SAMPLE optimum -- feature and threshold chosen on the same 250 queries

failure_mode_rule.rule: serve base when bod_media_share >= 0.5 and base_media_share < bod_media_share
failure_mode_rule.note: hand-designed from the known failure mode; hindsight-selected, not held out

oracle_categorical.rule: ORACLE -- serve the per-query categorical_winner (upper bound, not achievable)

oracle_click.rule: ORACLE -- serve the per-query click_winner (upper bound, not achievable)

oracle_headroom.note: even a perfect per-query oracle only moves junk@10 by ~3pt and hit@10 by ~5.6pt, because BoD already wins or ties the large majority of queries -- the routing prize is small before any signal question is asked
